environment.description: Same Ktor microservice packaged as a container image deployed via AWS Lambda with a Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda resource policy does not include any principal wildcard (*) statements - it specifies only the ARN of the internal API Gateway service role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/apigw-invoke-notifications) as the allowed principal. There is no additional auth bypass mechanism; the Lambda service itself enforces SigV4 signature validation on the Function URL before the container receives any request. Unsigned or incorrectly signed requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda invoke endpoint before reaching application code. Note: the Function URL endpoint is publicly resolvable at https://abc123def456.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/ but IAM auth enforcement occurs at the AWS infrastructure layer prior to cold start or request routing.

config.runtime: AWS Lambda container image (JVM 17 custom runtime)
config.smtp: Amazon SES with production sending enabled
config.vpc: No VPC attachment - runs in Lambda service VPC
